commits.message:
[Feature] Add Mooncake V2 layerwise push connector (#20940)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

Add an experimental Ascend Mooncake V2 layerwise push path alongside the
existing pull connector. D allocates destination KV blocks and publishes
request routing through the Ascend layerwise proxy's metaserver. P
discovers D cache layouts from the D scheduler metadata service and
submits layer WRITE batches through a thread pool.

- Track outstanding WRITE futures per destination engine. Ordinary layer
hooks accumulate ready layers while that engine is busy; the last layer
attempts to flush the backlog and queues DONE after the request's
submitted WRITE dependencies.
- Keep `wait_for_save` as the step barrier and fallback for late
metadata, caches without layer hooks, and connector-only steps. D
aggregates producer-rank completions before reporting receive success or
failure to the scheduler.
- Reuse common metadata and Mamba address calculation. Handle chunked
prefill, cached prefixes, multiple cache groups per physical layer, TP
head partitions/replicas, and final-chunk-only SWA/circular/Mamba state
transfers. Exclude speculative Mamba tail blocks from P transfer
metadata.
- Convert WRITE errors into request-level error DONE without raising
them into the model thread. Cancellation before first worker dispatch
carries D completion endpoints and needs no cache discovery;
cancellation after dispatch preserves existing WRITE dependencies.

This draft is developed against the paired vLLM layerwise work in
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/62504. Native WRITE calls are
assumed to return within the configured transport timeout (30 seconds in
the current target environment); `wait_for_save` drains submitted tasks.
The connector contract treats a synchronous WRITE return, including an
error return, as completion of all host/device accesses. Violations of
that contract belong to the Mooncake/HIXL backend; no additional
post-return drain protocol is planned in this connector.

Current scope requires DCP=1 and no P request preemption. KVPP is
outside the support plan and is not a future implementation TODO.
Existing layout/topology guards remain in force; full model/topology
support is not established by host tests.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

Yes. Select `MooncakePushConnector` on both P and D, with `kv_role` set
to `kv_producer` and `kv_consumer`, respectively. `MooncakeConnectorV2`
remains the pull alias.

Includes release note fragment `release_notes/fragments/20940.yaml`.

### TODO / remaining work

#### Functional follow-ups

- [ ] **DCP support**: implement DCP sequence/rank mapping and
completion accounting. DCP > 1 is currently rejected.
- [ ] **P preemption and resume**: retire old transfers before source
blocks are reused, and rebuild transfer progress for resumed
allocations. Ordinary request abort, including abort before first worker
dispatch, is already implemented.
- [ ] **Metaserver batch progress**: acknowledge metadata acceptance
separately from P completion. Currently each POST occupies one of 32
threads until P finishes; a multi-prompt batch needing more than 32
metadata submissions through one D engine can wait on its own queued
submissions until timeout. Increasing the pool size alone does not
remove this dependency.

#### Validation still required before merge

- [ ] **Real NPU correctness**: verify actual WRITE payloads and event
ordering, early/final-layer DONE, cancellation, chunk boundaries and
prefix hits; cover supported TP/PCP/PP combinations, mixed cache groups,
graph execution and speculative/stateful model paths. These are
validation gaps, not claims of implemented support for every
combination.
- [ ] **Performance**: measure throughput, TTFT/TPOT and thread-pool
contention against the reference layerwise flow; host tests do not
establish a speedup.

### How was this patch tested?

- At commit `49c3bad3a`, **92 host-isolated tests passed** across
connector, push-scheduler, push-worker and push-sending tests. The local
harness extracts the actual scheduler/worker classes with framework/NPU
initialization isolated. Protocol checks use real HTTP/ZMQ sockets;
WRITE/event checks use mocks, with CPU byte-copy checks for address
mapping. This is not a full package-import or NPU E2E result.
- Consolidated duplicate abort/completion tests and equivalent input
variants; retained protocol, byte-copy and concurrency regressions.
Batch failure and pending-prefix progress now use normal inputs/hooks
instead of mutating unrelated internal state.
- Covered metadata discovery and retry, chunk boundaries, cached
prefixes, per-engine submission gating, final-layer backlog flushing,
out-of-order WRITE completion, request failure propagation, multi-rank
completion, pre-dispatch abort without cache discovery, cancellation
waiting for submitted WRITE, and Mamba speculative-tail exclusion.
- Ruff lint/format checks and `git diff --check` passed for the modified
implementation/tests.
- Targeted mypy 1.11.1 (the repository-pinned version) passed for all 11
Mooncake source files and, in a separate pass, all 13 Mooncake UT files.
Checks used installed pyzmq 27.3.0, msgspec and test dependencies with
`--follow-imports skip --ignore-missing-imports --check-untyped-defs
--python-version 3.11`. Both source and UT pyzmq export errors were
reproduced before the fixes. Other missing framework/NPU dependencies
remain ignored locally; this is not full-dependency CI validation.
- CI run
[42224301945](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/42224301945)
at `d5e67b555` passed pre-commit and mypy for Python 3.10/3.11/3.12.
Both CPU UT matrices reported the same 27 scheduler fixture setup
errors: the UT accessed `base_scheduler.FullAttentionSpec`, which the
production module does not export. Commit `49c3bad3a` imports cache
specs directly from `vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface`. The local harness was
also corrected to stop exporting unimported cache-spec mocks: it
reproduced all 27 errors before the UT fix, then passed all 92 tests
after it. Targeted mypy for all 13 Mooncake UT files and Ruff passed;
full CPU CI for the new commit is pending. Local pre-commit remains
intentionally skipped at the user's request. No NPU correctness or
performance run has been completed for this revision.

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**
- [x] **Regression test**
- [x] **Error / failure path coverage**
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**
- [ ] **Performance impact**: NPU benchmarks pending.

- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/24420b7a341af37a9bc3186e6fc6062512e0aa58

 This transfer path still requires end-to-end validation on Ascend hardware, including configurations that combine it with `AscendStoreConnector` through `MultiConnector`.
 
+#### Mooncake V2 Layerwise Push Connector
+
+Set `kv_connector` to `MooncakePushConnector` on P and D, with `kv_role` set to
+`kv_producer` and `kv_consumer`, respectively. Use
+`examples/disaggregated_prefill_v1/load_balance_proxy_layerwise_server_example.py`
+as the proxy. This experimental path supports PCP/TP routing and PP layer
+lookup; workers currently require DCP=1 and do not support KVPP.
+
+The proxy sends the request to D first. After allocating blocks, D's scheduler
+submits an immutable destination snapshot to a 32-worker HTTP thread pool,
+which posts to the proxy's `/v1/metaserver`. The scheduler continues scheduling
+without waiting for HTTP. The proxy forwards the destination parameters to P;
+no Mooncake bootstrap server or worker Ready handshake is used.
+
+While P has outstanding transfers, its scheduler sets `has_sync_kv_loads=True`
+so that `start_load_kv()` prepares request state before forward and layer hooks.
+P queries D's scheduler metadata service for cache layouts. Its transfer
+pool writes each layer and sends completion to D workers. D waits for all P
+ranks, including ranks with no data to send, before reporting receive completion.
+Completions that arrive before D's worker allocation metadata are buffered.
+P waits for this step's metadata queries, WRITEs and terminal DONE callbacks
+before returning worker results. Normal prefill completion releases KV without
+delay-free; asynchronous scheduling remains enabled. This path currently assumes
+successful transfer; request-level transfer failure reporting is TODO. Early
+cancellation still retains the existing delayed-release protection.
+
+P follows this lifecycle:
+
+1. `update_state_after_alloc()` records source blocks. `build_connector_meta()`
+   appends new chunk blocks and snapshots the scheduled prompt token range.
+2. `start_load_kv()` installs the chunk metadata and starts or reuses the D
+   metadata query. Destination topology is checked once per request after the
+   query completes. The previous step's sends have already been drained.
+3. `save_kv_layer()` records a device event for the layer's caches and submits
+   available ranges to the transfer pool. SWA, circular and Mamba caches wait
+   for the final chunk; non-owner ranks send DONE without a WRITE.
+4. The runner calls `wait_for_save()` to publish remaining cache ranges and
+   drain this step's transfers. With speculative decoding, this happens during
+   finalization after draft execution. `get_transfer_results()` polls results
+   without invoking this barrier or marking unfinished caches ready.
+5. `request_finished()` releases normally completed requests immediately and
+   sends a worker bookkeeping cleanup notice on the next step. Published
+   requests cancelled before completion keep their blocks until workers report
+   `finished_sending`; only those cancellations are forwarded to core for
+   delayed release. P preemption remains unsupported and is a TODO.
+
+Layer cache grouping uses the name prefix before the first numeric component
+and the extracted layer index. For example, `model.layers.0.attn` and
+`mtp.layer.0.self_attn` belong to separate namespaces even though both have index
+zero. Names must still contain the numeric layer index expected by
+`extract_layer_index()`. With multiple namespaces, layer hooks publish only
+their own group's caches; final flushing and DONE submission happen in
+`wait_for_save()` after draft execution rather than at the largest layer index.
+
+The existing metaserver responds after P finishes. Consequently, outstanding
+HTTP requests occupy pool threads for that duration. A multi-prompt request
+must fit within both D's concurrent allocation capacity and the HTTP pool;
+otherwise waiting sibling notifications can exhaust the pool. Connection
+establishment failures are retried up to three attempts; response failures are
+not replayed because P may already have been dispatched. Background HTTP
+failures are collected in a later scheduling step and sent to D workers. A
+connection-establishment failure finishes that receive as failed. Invalid
+metaserver URLs and rejected pool submissions also fail new receives before
+publishing their addresses. When P may
+already have been dispatched, D marks the receive failed but retains its blocks
+until all P ranks report drained writes. Late HTTP errors do not reopen completed
+receives. Each request is assumed to use one P engine with a fixed topology.
+On D, missing terminal completions and unconfirmed WRITE drain mark only the
+affected receive as failed; they do not stop the worker. Failure is reported together with receive completion
+once all source WRITEs are confirmed drained. Until then, the request and its
+blocks remain pending (client cancellation can end the request but does not
+release its blocks). A late drained DONE can complete the receive.
+Cancellation/drain recovery for a permanently lost P is not yet
+implemented, so repeated failures can exhaust D's available KV blocks. A failure
+of the shared DONE listener remains fatal.
+
 #### Mooncake D2RH Connector
 
 D2RH (device-to-remote-host) splits KV cache transfer into two stages:

+    address = []
+
+    def serve_metadata():
+        with Context() as ctx, ctx.socket(SocketType.REP) as sock:
+            sock.setsockopt(SocketOption.RCVTIMEO, 3000)

+            address.append(sock.getsockopt(SocketOption.LAST_ENDPOINT).decode())
+            started.set()
+            assert msgspec.msgpack.decode(sock.recv()) == [b"get_meta_msg", "d"]
+            sock.send(msgspec.msgpack.encode(remote_metadata()))
+
+    thread = threading.Thread(target=serve_metadata)
+    thread.start()
+    assert started.wait(3)

+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(worker, "_send_done", push_worker.MooncakePushConnectorWorker._send_done.__get__(worker))

+    message.update(scheduler_address=address[0], completion_address=completion.address)

+    finally:
+        completion.shutdown()
+        thread.join(4)
+        assert not thread.is_alive()

+    def __init__(self, vllm_config: VllmConfig, engine_id: str, kv_cache_config: "KVCacheConfig") -> None:
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, engine_id, kv_cache_config)

+        self._reqs_need_send_layerwise: dict[str, tuple[Request, BlockIds]] = {}
+        self._reqs_sent_to_worker: set[str] = set()
+        self._reqs_need_send: dict[str, float] = {}
+        self._reqs_pending_send: dict[str, float] = {}

+        meta = MooncakeConnectorMetadata()
+        if self.kv_transfer_config.is_kv_producer:

+            # before core reuses its blocks; resumed requests need fresh progress.
+            # Updating resumed block IDs alone does not provide that handshake.
+            # Ordinary request cancellation is handled by request_finished below.
+            # The current deployment assumes P requests are not preempted.

+                    continue

+                    else:

+                    continue

+                    ),
+                    kv_transfer_params=request.kv_transfer_params,
+                )

+            self._reqs_pending_send = {}
+            meta.push_aborted_requests = self._reqs_aborted
+            self._reqs_aborted = {}
+            # P layer hooks need request state before forward, including steps
+            # that only drain outstanding transfers or process cancellations.
+            if self._reqs_need_send_layerwise or meta.requests_to_send or meta.push_aborted_requests:
+                scheduler_output.has_sync_kv_loads = True
+

+            # decide when failed receives are safe to release.
+            if self.metaserver_client is not None:
+                meta.push_failed_requests = self.metaserver_client.get_failed_requests()
+            for req_id, (req, block_ids, num_external_tokens) in self._reqs_pending_recv.items():

+                    request_id=req_id,
+                    local_block_ids=block_ids,
+                    num_external_tokens=num_external_tokens,
+                    kv_transfer_params=req.kv_transfer_params,
+                )

+    def request_finished(self, request: "Request", block_ids: BlockIds) -> tuple[bool, dict[str, Any] | None]:
+        if not self.kv_transfer_config.is_kv_producer:
+            # Core pins cancelled D receives until finished_recving.
+            return False, None
+        req_id = request.request_id
+        params = request.kv_transfer_params
+        if not params or not params.get("do_remote_decode"):
+            return False, None
+        normal_finish = request.status in (RequestStatus.FINISHED_LENGTH_CAPPED, RequestStatus.FINISHED_STOPPED)
+        if not normal_finish:
+            # Notify workers even if cancellation precedes the first dispatch.
+            self._reqs_aborted[req_id] = dict(
+                remote_request_id=params["remote_request_id"],
+                remote_engine_id=params["remote_engine_id"],
+                remote_worker_addresses=tuple(tuple(address) for address in params["remote_worker_addresses"]),
+            )
+        if req_id not in self._reqs_need_send_layerwise:
+            return False, None
+        # Normal prefill output is returned only after the worker's send barrier.
+        # Transfer failures are reported to D through the worker's DONE status.
+        if normal_finish or req_id not in self._reqs_sent_to_worker:
+            if normal_finish and req_id in self._reqs_sent_to_worker:
+                # Retire worker bookkeeping on the next step; KV is already safe to free.
+                self._reqs_pending_send[req_id] = time.monotonic()
+            self._reqs_sent_to_worker.discard(req_id)
+            self._reqs_need_send_layerwise.pop(req_id)
+            return False, None
+        # Includes cancellation: submitted WRITEs may still read P blocks.
+        self._reqs_need_send[req_id] = time.monotonic()
+        self._reqs_pending_send[req_id] = self._reqs_need_send[req_id]
+        return True, None
+
+    def update_connector_output(self, connector_output: "KVConnectorOutput") -> None:
+        if not self.kv_transfer_config.is_kv_producer:
+            return
+        finished_sending: set[str] = set()
+        for req_id in connector_output.finished_sending or ():
+            if req_id in self._reqs_need_send:
+                finished_sending.add(req_id)
+                self._reqs_need_send.pop(req_id)
+                self._reqs_sent_to_worker.discard(req_id)
+                self._reqs_need_send_layerwise.pop(req_id)
+                self._reqs_pending_send.pop(req_id, None)
+                self._reqs_aborted.pop(req_id, None)
+        # Normal requests were already freed; only delayed cancellations need
+        # finished_sending forwarded to core.
+        connector_output.finished_sending = finished_sending or None
+
+    def set_xfer_handshake_metadata_from_workers(
+        self, metadata: Mapping[int | tuple[int, ...], KVConnectorHandshakeMetadata]
+    ) -> None:
+        """Serve D cache layouts and publish its worker completion endpoints."""
+        if self.kv_transfer_config.is_kv_producer:
+            return
+        use_kv_pp = self.ascend_config.kvpp_config.size > 1
+        if use_kv_pp and self.dcp_size != 1:
+            raise ValueError("Mooncake KVPP cannot be combined with DCP")
+        thread = MooncakePushMetadataThread(
+            self.side_channel_host,
+            self.side_channel_port,
+            self.engine_id,
+            metadata,
+            self.tp_size,
+            self.pp_size,
+            self.pcp_size,
+            self.dcp_size,
+            use_kv_pp,
+            threading.Event(),
+        )
+        if self._metadata_thread is not None:
+            if self._metadata_thread.error is not None:
+                raise RuntimeError("Mooncake scheduler metadata thread failed") from self._metadata_thread.error
+            if self._metadata_thread.encoded_metadata != thread.encoded_metadata:
+                raise RuntimeError("Replacing active D worker metadata is not supported")
+            return
+        try:
+            thread.start()
+        except Exception:
+            thread.shutdown()
+            raise
+        self._metadata_thread = thread
+        groups = msgspec.msgpack.decode(thread.encoded_metadata, type=MooncakeTransferMetadataGroups)
+        self._remote_worker_addresses = tuple(
+            (pp_rank, pcp_rank, tp_rank, make_zmq_path("tcp", worker.local_ip, worker.handshake_port))
+            for pp_rank, pp in groups.metadata_by_pp_rank.items()
+            for pcp_rank, pcp in pp.metadata_by_pcp_rank.items()
+            for tp_rank, worker in pcp.metadata_by_tp_rank.items()
+        )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM-Ascend project
+"""Layerwise Push: proxy-provided destinations, P WRITE pool and D DONE listener."""
+
+import queue
+import threading
+import time
+from concurrent.futures import Future, ThreadPoolExecutor
+from concurrent.futures import wait as wait_futures
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from typing import Any
+
+import msgspec
+import torch

+from vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.base import KVConnectorTransferResults
+from vllm.logger import logger
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import extract_layer_index
+from vllm.utils.network_utils import make_zmq_path, make_zmq_socket
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import (
+    FullAttentionSpec,
+    MambaSpec,
+    MLAAttentionSpec,
+    SlidingWindowMLASpec,
+    SlidingWindowSpec,
+)
+from zmq.constants import SocketOption, SocketType
+from zmq.error import Again, ZMQError
+from zmq.sugar.context import Context
+
+from vllm_ascend.core.kv_cache_interface import is_circular_kv_cache_spec
+from vllm_ascend.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_p2p.mooncake.base_worker import MooncakeBaseConnectorWorker
+from vllm_ascend.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_p2p.mooncake.metadata import (
+    MooncakeConnectorMetadata,
+    MooncakeTransferMetadataGroups,
+    PushSendReqMeta,
+)
+from vllm_ascend.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_p2p.mooncake.utils import (
+    SizedDict,
+    ensure_zmq_recv,
+    ensure_zmq_send,
+    zmq_ctx,
+)
+
+# Rank tuples are (PP, PCP, TP), matching scheduler handshake keys.
+WorkerRank = tuple[int, int, int]
+
+
+@dataclass
+class _ReceiveState:
+    request_id: str
+    start_time: float
+    expected_ranks: set[WorkerRank] = field(default_factory=set)
+    finished_ranks: set[WorkerRank] = field(default_factory=set)
+    failed: bool = False
+
+
+class MooncakeDecodeListenerThread(threading.Thread):
+    """Listen for P worker DONE messages on D; acknowledge and queue results."""
+
+    def __init__(self, worker: "MooncakePushConnectorWorker") -> None:
+        super().__init__(daemon=True, name="MooncakeDecodeListenerThread")
+        self.stop_event = worker._stop_event
+        self.ready_event = threading.Event()
+        self.error: Exception | None = None
+        self.engine_id = worker.engine_id
+        self.rank = [worker.pp_rank, worker.pcp_rank, worker.tp_rank]
+        self.address = make_zmq_path("tcp", worker.side_channel_host, worker.handshake_port)
+        self.result_queue = worker._result_queue
+
+    def start(self) -> None:
+        super().start()
+        if not self.ready_event.wait(timeout=10):
+            self.shutdown()
+            raise TimeoutError(f"Timed out starting {self.name}")
+        if self.error is not None:
+            self.shutdown()
+            raise RuntimeError(f"{self.name} failed to start") from self.error
+
+    def shutdown(self) -> None:
+        self.stop_event.set()
+        if self.ident is not None:
+            self.join()
+
+    def run(self) -> None:
+        try:
+            with zmq_ctx(SocketType.ROUTER, self.address) as sock:
+                sock.setsockopt(SocketOption.RCVTIMEO, 100)
+                sock.setsockopt(SocketOption.SNDTIMEO, 1000)
+                self.address = sock.getsockopt(SocketOption.LAST_ENDPOINT).decode()
+                self.ready_event.set()
+                while not self.stop_event.is_set():
+                    try:
+                        frames = sock.recv_multipart()
+                    except Again:
+                        continue
+                    if self.stop_event.is_set():
+                        return
+                    self._handle_done_message(sock, frames)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            self.error = exc
+            logger.exception("%s failed", self.name)
+        finally:
+            self.ready_event.set()
+
+    def _handle_done_message(self, sock: Any, frames: list[bytes]) -> None:
+        identity, *payload = frames
+        # Support REQ (empty delimiter) and DEALER callbacks.
+        delimiter = [b""] if payload and payload[0] == b"" else []
+        if delimiter:
+            payload = payload[1:]
+        completion = None
+        try:
+            if len(payload) != 1:
+                raise ValueError("Expected one completion payload")
+            message = msgspec.msgpack.decode(payload[0])
+            if not isinstance(message, dict) or message.get("kind") != "done":
+                raise ValueError("Expected DONE")
+            if message.get("consumer_engine_id") != self.engine_id or message.get("consumer_rank") != self.rank:
+                raise ValueError("DONE belongs to another consumer")
+            rank = message.get("producer_rank")
+            if not isinstance(rank, list) or len(rank) != 3 or any(type(v) is not int or v < 0 for v in rank):
+                raise ValueError("Invalid producer rank")
+            sizes = message.get("producer_sizes")
+            if (
+                not isinstance(sizes, list)
+                or len(sizes) != 3
+                or any(type(size) is not int or size <= 0 for size in sizes)
+                or any(value >= size for value, size in zip(rank, sizes))
+            ):
+                raise ValueError("Invalid producer topology")
+            for key in ("request_id", "producer_engine_id"):
+                if not isinstance(message.get(key), str) or not message[key]:
+                    raise ValueError(f"Missing completion identity: {key}")
+            if message.get("status") not in ("ok", "error"):
+                raise ValueError("DONE requires a transfer status")
+            completion = message
+            reply = {"kind": "done_ack", "request_id": message["request_id"]}
+        except Exception as exc:
+            # Isolate malformed network messages, including decoder errors
+            # such as RecursionError, from the shared listener's lifetime.
+            logger.warning("Failed to parse Mooncake DONE message: %s", exc)
+            reply = {"kind": "error", "error": str(exc)}
+        try:
+            sock.send_multipart([identity, *delimiter, msgspec.msgpack.encode(reply)])
+        except ZMQError:
+            logger.exception("Failed to acknowledge Push completion")
+            if completion is not None:
+                # Preserve request failure while waiting for the other sources.
+                completion["status"] = "error"
+        if completion is not None:
+            self.result_queue.put(("done", completion["request_id"], completion))
+

+class MooncakePushConnectorWorker(MooncakeBaseConnectorWorker):
+    """Coordinate P layer batches and D completion accounting."""
+
+    def __init__(self, vllm_config, engine_id, kv_cache_config) -> None:
+        # TODO: add DCP rank/sequence mapping and completion accounting before
+        # accepting DCP > 1; current worker identities contain only PP/PCP/TP.
+        if vllm_config.parallel_config.decode_context_parallel_size != 1:

+        self._result_queue: queue.SimpleQueue = queue.SimpleQueue()
+        self._reqs_recv_state: dict[str, _ReceiveState] = {}
+        self._finished_requests: SizedDict = SizedDict(max_size=16000)
+        self._decode_listener_thread: MooncakeDecodeListenerThread | None = None
+        self._pending_completions: SizedDict = SizedDict(max_size=16000)
+        self._reqs_send_state: dict[str, SendReqInfo] = {}
+        self._prefilling_request_ids: tuple[str, ...] = ()
+        self._pending_sends: list[tuple[LayerTransferBatch, Future]] = []

+        self._remote_metadata: SizedDict = SizedDict(max_size=128)
+        self._sender_executor: ThreadPoolExecutor | None = None
+        self._zmq_context: Context | None = None
+
+    def register_kv_caches(self, kv_caches: dict[str, "torch.Tensor | list[torch.Tensor]"]) -> None:
+        super().register_kv_caches(kv_caches)
+        if self.kv_transfer_config.is_kv_producer:
+            # KVPP is outside the Push support plan.
+            if self.ascend_config.kvpp_config.size > 1:
+                raise ValueError("Mooncake Push does not support KVPP yet")
+            self._device = torch.npu.current_device()
+            self._layer_indices = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(self.transfer_metadata.layer_names)}
+            model_type = self.vllm_config.model_config.hf_text_config.model_type
+            num_attn_module = 2 if model_type in ("longcat_flash", "longcat_flash_ngram") else 1
+            self._layer_index_by_name: dict[str, tuple[str, int]] = {}
+            for name in self._layer_indices:
+                layer_index = extract_layer_index(name, num_attn_module)
+                parts = name.split(".")
+                namespace = ".".join(parts[: next(i for i, part in enumerate(parts) if part.isdecimal())])
+                # Target and draft layers can reuse layer numbers, but not KV readiness.
+                self._layer_index_by_name[name] = (namespace, layer_index)
+            self._layer_names_by_index: dict[tuple[str, int], list[str]] = {}
+            for name, layer_index in self._layer_index_by_name.items():
+                self._layer_names_by_index.setdefault(layer_index, []).append(name)
+            # Layer numbers do not establish execution order across models.
+            # Multiple namespaces finalize at wait_for_save after draft execution.
+            namespaces = {namespace for namespace, _ in self._layer_names_by_index}
+            self._last_layer_index = max(self._layer_names_by_index) if len(namespaces) == 1 else None
+            # Shared Mamba address calculation uses the same registered descriptors as Pull.
+            for name in ("layer_names", "kv_caches_base_addr", "block_shapes", "block_strides", "block_lens"):
+                setattr(self, name, getattr(self.transfer_metadata, name))
+            self._zmq_context = Context()
+            self._sender_executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(
+                max_workers=32,
+                initializer=torch.npu.set_device,
+                initargs=(self._device,),
+                thread_name_prefix="MooncakePushSending",
+            )
+            return
+        self._decode_listener_thread = MooncakeDecodeListenerThread(self)
+        try:
+            self._decode_listener_thread.start()
+        except Exception:
+            self.shutdown()
+            raise
+
+    def start_load_kv(self, metadata: MooncakeConnectorMetadata) -> None:
+        if self.kv_transfer_config.is_kv_producer:
+            # The previous step's wait_for_save has joined its WRITE tasks.
+            for local_request_id, request in metadata.push_send_requests.items():
+                state = self._reqs_send_state.setdefault(request.request_id, SendReqInfo(local_request_id))
+                state.metadata = request
+                if not state.destinations:
+                    self._prepare_destinations(state, request)
+                # A prefix hit is already resident before this forward.
+                if not state.available_layers and request.num_computed_tokens:
+                    event = torch.npu.Event()
+                    event.record()
+                    state.available_layers = {
+                        name: (request.num_computed_tokens, event) for name in self._layer_indices
+                    }
+            for state in self._reqs_send_state.values():
+                if state.local_request_id in metadata.requests_to_send:
+                    state.inference_finished = True
+            for local_request_id, params in metadata.push_aborted_requests.items():
+                request_id = params["remote_request_id"]
+                state = self._reqs_send_state.setdefault(request_id, SendReqInfo(local_request_id))
+                state.inference_finished = True
+                state.error = "P request aborted"
+                if not state.destinations:
+                    # No WRITE was dispatched: notify D without querying cache
+                    # metadata. Existing states retain their WRITE dependencies.
+                    for pp, pcp, tp, address in params["remote_worker_addresses"]:
+                        rank = (pp, pcp, tp)
+                        state.destinations[rank] = RemoteReqInfo(
+                            dict(
+                                request_id=request_id,
+                                producer_engine_id=self.engine_id,
+                                producer_rank=[self.pp_rank, self.pcp_rank, self.tp_rank],
+                                consumer_engine_id=params["remote_engine_id"],
+                                consumer_rank=list(rank),
+                                completion_address=address,
+                                num_computed_tokens=0,
+                                num_external_tokens=0,
+                            ),
+                            metadata_future=None,
+                        )
+            self._prefilling_request_ids = tuple(req.request_id for req in metadata.push_send_requests.values())
+            self._process_sending_requests()
+
+        else:
+            for request_id, recv_request in metadata.push_requests.items():
+                if (
+                    recv_request.request_id in self._finished_requests
+                    or recv_request.request_id in self._reqs_recv_state
+                ):
+                    continue
+                self._reqs_recv_state[recv_request.request_id] = _ReceiveState(request_id, time.monotonic())
+                for completion in self._pending_completions.pop(recv_request.request_id, {}).values():
+                    self._result_queue.put(("done", recv_request.request_id, completion))
+            for request_id, not_dispatched in metadata.push_failed_requests.items():
+                recv_state = self._reqs_recv_state.get(request_id)
+                if recv_state is None:
+                    # Already finished, or no external KV was needed.
+                    continue
+                recv_state.failed = True
+                if not_dispatched:
+                    self._result_queue.put(("failed", request_id, None))
+                # Otherwise wait for all P ranks or the receive timeout.
+                # Mark failure before consuming queued DONEs.
+
+    def _get_remote_metadata(self, params: dict[str, Any]) -> MooncakeTransferMetadataGroups:
+        path = params["scheduler_address"]
+        sock = make_zmq_socket(self._zmq_context, path, SocketType.REQ, bind=False)
+        try:
+            timeout = max(1, int(envs.VLLM_MOONCAKE_CONNECTOR_TIMEOUT * 1000))
+            sock.setsockopt(SocketOption.SNDTIMEO, timeout)
+            sock.setsockopt(SocketOption.RCVTIMEO, timeout)
+            ensure_zmq_send(sock, msgspec.msgpack.encode((b"get_meta_msg", params["consumer_engine_id"])), path)
+            metadata = msgspec.msgpack.decode(ensure_zmq_recv(sock, path), type=MooncakeTransferMetadataGroups)
+        finally:
+            sock.close(linger=0)
+        if metadata.engine_id != params["consumer_engine_id"] or metadata.dcp_size != 1:
+            raise ValueError("Push requires matching D engine metadata with DCP=1")
+        if metadata.use_kv_pp:
+            raise ValueError("Push does not support KVPP yet")
+        return metadata
+
+    def _send_done(self, params: dict[str, Any], error: str | None) -> bool:
+        """A failed callback never retries the request or retains P source blocks."""
+        path = params["completion_address"]
+        sock = None
+        try:
+            sock = make_zmq_socket(self._zmq_context, path, SocketType.REQ, bind=False)
+            timeout = max(1, int(envs.VLLM_MOONCAKE_CONNECTOR_TIMEOUT * 1000))
+            sock.setsockopt(SocketOption.SNDTIMEO, timeout)
+            sock.setsockopt(SocketOption.RCVTIMEO, timeout)
+            message = {
+                key: params[key]
+                for key in (
+                    "request_id",
+                    "producer_engine_id",
+                    "producer_rank",
+                    "consumer_engine_id",
+                    "consumer_rank",
+                )
+            }
+            message.update(
+                kind="done",
+                status="error" if error else "ok",
+                producer_sizes=[self.pp_size, self.pcp_size, self.tp_size],
+            )
+            if error:
+                message["error"] = error
+            ensure_zmq_send(sock, msgspec.msgpack.encode(message), path)
+            reply = msgspec.msgpack.decode(ensure_zmq_recv(sock, path))
+            if reply != {"kind": "done_ack", "request_id": params["request_id"]}:
+                raise ValueError("Invalid DONE ACK")
+            return True
+        except Exception:
+            # D may have died. Its receive timeout handles a missing DONE.
+            logger.exception("Failed to notify Push completion for %s at %s", params["request_id"], path)
+            return False
+        finally:
+            if sock is not None:
+                sock.close(linger=0)
+
+    def _prepare_destinations(self, state: SendReqInfo, request: PushSendReqMeta) -> None:
+        path = make_zmq_path("tcp", request.remote_host, request.remote_port)
+        params = dict(
+            request_id=request.request_id,
+            producer_engine_id=self.engine_id,
+            producer_rank=[self.pp_rank, self.pcp_rank, self.tp_rank],
+            consumer_engine_id=request.remote_engine_id,
+            scheduler_address=path,
+            block_ids=request.remote_block_ids,
+            num_computed_tokens=request.remote_num_computed_tokens,
+            num_external_tokens=request.remote_num_external_tokens,
+        )
+        key = (request.remote_engine_id, path)
+        future = self._remote_metadata.get(key)
+        if future is not None and future.done() and (future.cancelled() or future.exception() is not None):
+            # Retry discovery for new requests after a transient D failure.
+            future = None
+        if future is None:
+            assert self._sender_executor is not None
+            future = self._sender_executor.submit(self._get_remote_metadata, params)
+            self._remote_metadata[key] = future
+        state.consumer_engine_id = request.remote_engine_id
+        for pp, pcp, tp, address in request.remote_worker_addresses:
+            rank = (pp, pcp, tp)
+            target = dict(params, consumer_rank=list(rank), completion_address=address)
+            state.destinations[rank] = RemoteReqInfo(target, future)
+        if not state.destinations:
+            raise ValueError("Missing D worker completion endpoints")
+
+    def _get_transfer_partition(
+        self, layer_name: str, remote: MooncakeTransferMetadataGroups, rank: WorkerRank
+    ) -> tuple[int, int, int] | None:
+        """Return source/destination head offsets and count, or None for a non-owner."""
+        local_index = self._layer_indices[layer_name]
+        pp = remote.metadata_by_pp_rank[rank[0]]
+        if layer_name not in pp.layer_names:
+            return None
+        remote_index = pp.layer_names.index(layer_name)
+        worker = pp.metadata_by_pcp_rank[rank[1]].metadata_by_tp_rank[rank[2]]
+        if remote_index not in worker.layer_indices:
+            return None
+        spec = self.kv_cache_specs[self.layer_name_to_spec_index[layer_name]]
+        local_rank = self.tp_rank
+        remote_rank = rank[2]
+        local_size, remote_size = self.tp_size, remote.tp_size
+        if isinstance(spec, MambaSpec):
+            if getattr(spec, "tp_replicated", False):
+                owner = (rank[2] * remote.pcp_size + rank[1]) % (self.tp_size * self.pcp_size)
+                return (0, 0, 1) if self.tp_rank * self.pcp_size + self.pcp_rank == owner else None
+            local_rank = self.tp_rank * self.pcp_size + self.pcp_rank
+            remote_rank = rank[2] * remote.pcp_size + rank[1]
+            local_size *= self.pcp_size
+            remote_size *= remote.pcp_size
+            larger, smaller = max(local_size, remote_size), min(local_size, remote_size)
+            if larger % smaller:
+                raise ValueError("Mamba P/D PCP*TP sizes must have an integer ratio")
+            ratio = larger // smaller
+            matched = (
+                local_rank // ratio == remote_rank if local_size >= remote_size else remote_rank // ratio == local_rank
+            )
+            return (0, 0, 1) if matched else None
+        whole = isinstance(spec, (MLAAttentionSpec, SlidingWindowMLASpec)) or is_circular_kv_cache_spec(spec)
+        if whole:
+            # Replicated pages: exactly one P worker writes each D replica.
+            owner = (rank[2] * remote.pcp_size + rank[1]) % (self.tp_size * self.pcp_size)
+            return (0, 0, 1) if self.tp_rank * self.pcp_size + self.pcp_rank == owner else None
+        if not isinstance(spec, (FullAttentionSpec, SlidingWindowSpec)):
+            raise ValueError(f"Unsupported Push cache spec: {type(spec).__name__}")
+        if self.pcp_rank != rank[1] % self.pcp_size:
+            return None
+        local_heads = self.transfer_metadata.block_shapes[local_index][0][0]
+        remote_heads = pp.block_shapes[remote_index][0][0]
+        totals = {heads * size for heads, size in ((local_heads, local_size), (remote_heads, remote_size)) if heads > 1}
+        if len(totals) > 1:
+            raise ValueError("Inconsistent P/D attention head counts")
+        total_heads = next(iter(totals), min(local_size, remote_size))
+        if max(total_heads, local_size) % min(total_heads, local_size) or max(total_heads, remote_size) % min(
+            total_heads, remote_size
+        ):
+            raise ValueError("Unsupported attention head partition")
+        # Where TP exceeds KV heads, choose only one P replica for each head.
+        replicas = max(1, local_size // total_heads)
+        if local_rank % replicas != remote_rank % replicas:
+            return None
+        local_start = local_rank // replicas * local_heads
+        remote_start = remote_rank // max(1, remote_size // total_heads) * remote_heads
+        start, end = max(local_start, remote_start), min(local_start + local_heads, remote_start + remote_heads)
+        return (start - local_start, start - remote_start, end - start) if start < end else None
+
+    def _build_layer_transfer_request(
+        self, request_id: str, state: SendReqInfo, destination: RemoteReqInfo, layer_name: str
+    ) -> tuple[LayerTransferRequest, Any] | None:
+        meta = state.metadata
+        assert meta is not None
+        params = destination.transfer_params
+        available, event = state.available_layers[layer_name]
+        end = min(available, params["num_computed_tokens"] + params["num_external_tokens"])
+        start = destination.sent_tokens.get(layer_name, params["num_computed_tokens"])
+        if start >= end:
+            return None
+        assert destination.metadata_future is not None
+        remote = destination.metadata_future.result()
+        pp = remote.metadata_by_pp_rank[params["consumer_rank"][0]]
+        local_index = self._layer_indices[layer_name]
+        remote_index = pp.layer_names.index(layer_name)
+        spec = self.kv_cache_specs[self.layer_name_to_spec_index[layer_name]]
+        final = available >= meta.num_prompt_tokens
+        final_only = (
+            isinstance(spec, MambaSpec)
+            or is_circular_kv_cache_spec(spec)
+            or getattr(spec, "sliding_window", None) is not None
+        )
+        if final_only and not final:
+            return None
+        local_blocks = meta.local_block_ids[self.transfer_metadata.group_indices[local_index]]
+        remote_blocks = params["block_ids"][pp.group_indices[remote_index]]
+        local_ids: list[int]
+        remote_ids: list[int]
+        if isinstance(spec, MambaSpec):
+            local_ids = [local_blocks[-1]]
+            remote_ids = [remote_blocks[-1]]
+            if not local_ids[0] or not remote_ids[0]:
+                raise ValueError("Required Mamba state block is not resident")
+        elif is_circular_kv_cache_spec(spec):
+            if len(local_blocks) != 1 or len(remote_blocks) != 1:
+                raise ValueError("Circular Push requires one state block per request")
+            local_scale = self.transfer_metadata.block_size_scales[local_index][0]
+            remote_scale = pp.block_size_scales[remote_index][0]
+            if local_scale != remote_scale:
+                raise ValueError("Circular Push requires equal P/D physical block counts")
+            local_ids = [local_blocks[0] * local_scale + i for i in range(local_scale)]
+            remote_ids = [remote_blocks[0] * remote_scale + i for i in range(remote_scale)]
+        else:
+            local_scale = self.transfer_metadata.block_size_scales[local_index][0]
+            remote_scale = pp.block_size_scales[remote_index][0]
+            block_size = self.transfer_metadata.layer_block_sizes[local_index] // local_scale
+            if block_size != pp.layer_block_sizes[remote_index] // remote_scale:
+                raise ValueError("Push requires equal P/D kernel block sizes")
+            if not final:
+                end = end // block_size * block_size
+            if end <= start:
+                return None
+            if final_only:
+                # Window tables retain logical positions, including null slots.
+                start = max(start, end - getattr(spec, "num_retained_tokens", spec.sliding_window - 1) - 1)
+            first, last = start // block_size, (end + block_size - 1) // block_size
+            local_ids, remote_ids = [], []
+            for index in range(first, last):
+                local_block = local_blocks[index // local_scale]
+                remote_block = remote_blocks[index // remote_scale]
+                if final_only and remote_block == 0:
+                    continue
+                if local_block == 0 or remote_block == 0:
+                    raise ValueError("Required Push block is not resident")
+                local_ids.append(local_block * local_scale + index % local_scale)
+                remote_ids.append(remote_block * remote_scale + index % remote_scale)
+        return LayerTransferRequest(request_id, tuple(local_ids), tuple(remote_ids), start, end), event
+
+    def _execute_layer_transfer(self, batch: LayerTransferBatch) -> str | None:
+        # Backend contract: synchronous WRITE returns only after host/device
+        # accesses finish, including on failure. The connector waits for this
+        # return before notifying D or allowing source blocks to be reused.
+        src_list: list[int] = []
+        dst_list: list[int] = []
+        length_list: list[int] = []
+        try:
+            local_index = self._layer_indices[batch.layer_name]
+            remote = batch.remote_metadata
+            pp = remote.metadata_by_pp_rank[batch.remote_rank[0]]
+            remote_index = pp.layer_names.index(batch.layer_name)
+            worker = pp.metadata_by_pcp_rank[batch.remote_rank[1]].metadata_by_tp_rank[batch.remote_rank[2]]
+            spec = self.kv_cache_specs[self.layer_name_to_spec_index[batch.layer_name]]
+            if isinstance(spec, MambaSpec):
+                self._append_mamba_transfer_addresses(
+                    spec,
+                    batch.remote_rank[1],
+                    batch.remote_rank[2],
+                    remote.tp_size,
+                    {
+                        (local_index, remote_index): [
+                            (req.request_id, list(req.local_block_ids), list(req.remote_block_ids))
+                            for req in batch.requests
+                        ]
+                    },
+                    pp,
+                    src_list,
+                    dst_list,
+                    length_list,
+                )
+            else:
+                partition = self._get_transfer_partition(batch.layer_name, remote, batch.remote_rank)
+                assert partition is not None
+                local_offset, remote_offset, heads = partition
+                whole = isinstance(spec, (MLAAttentionSpec, SlidingWindowMLASpec)) or is_circular_kv_cache_spec(spec)
+                local = self.transfer_metadata
+                for cache_index, (local_addr, remote_addr) in enumerate(
+                    zip(local.kv_caches_base_addr[local_index], worker.kv_caches_base_addr[remote_index], strict=True)
+                ):
+                    local_len = local.block_lens[local_index][cache_index]
+                    remote_len = pp.block_lens[remote_index][cache_index]
+                    if not whole:
+                        local_len //= local.block_shapes[local_index][cache_index][0]
+                        remote_len //= pp.block_shapes[remote_index][cache_index][0]
+                    if local_len != remote_len:
+                        raise ValueError("P/D cache slice lengths differ")
+                    for req in batch.requests:
+                        for local_block, remote_block in zip(req.local_block_ids, req.remote_block_ids, strict=True):
+                            src_list.append(
+                                local_addr
+                                + local_block * local.block_strides[local_index][cache_index]
+                                + local_offset * local_len
+                            )
+                            dst_list.append(
+                                remote_addr
+                                + remote_block * pp.block_strides[remote_index][cache_index]
+                                + remote_offset * remote_len
+                            )
+                            length_list.append(local_len * heads)
+            batch.event.synchronize()
+            if src_list:
+                session = f"{worker.local_ip}:{worker.te_rpc_port}"
+                ret = self.engine.batch_transfer_sync_write(session, src_list, dst_list, length_list)
+                if ret < 0:
+                    return f"Mooncake WRITE failed: session={session}, ret={ret}"
+        except Exception as exc:
+            return str(exc) or type(exc).__name__
+        return None
+
+    def _process_sending_requests(self, wait: bool = False, *, layer_hook: bool = False, force: bool = False) -> None:
+        """Collect WRITE results and submit ready layers; never send DONE here."""
+        pending = []
+        for batch, future in self._pending_sends:
+            if not wait and not future.done():
+                pending.append((batch, future))
+                continue
+            try:
+                error = future.result()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                error = str(exc) or type(exc).__name__
+            if error:
+                logger.error(
+                    "Push transfer failed: layer=%s, rank=%s, error=%s", batch.layer_name, batch.remote_rank, error
+                )
+            for req in batch.requests:
+                state = self._reqs_send_state[req.request_id]
+                destination = state.destinations[batch.remote_rank]
+                destination.pending_layers.remove(batch.layer_name)
+                if error:
+                    state.error = error
+                else:
+                    destination.sent_tokens[batch.layer_name] = req.end_token
+        self._pending_sends = pending
+        self._sending_futures = {
+            engine_id: unfinished
+            for engine_id, futures in self._sending_futures.items()
+            if (unfinished := [future for future in futures if not future.done()])
+        }
+        batches: dict[
+            tuple[str, WorkerRank, str, int],
+            tuple[MooncakeTransferMetadataGroups, Any, list[LayerTransferRequest]],
+        ] = {}
+        # A free engine flushes every ready layer accumulated while it was busy.
+        # The last layer and the step boundary bypass this submission gate.
+        request_ids = self._prefilling_request_ids if layer_hook else self._reqs_send_state
+        now = time.monotonic() if wait else 0
+        for request_id in request_ids:
+            state = self._reqs_send_state[request_id]
+            # Metadata/WRITE waits may have crossed the request's deadline.
+            if wait and state.error is None and now - state.start_time > envs.VLLM_MOONCAKE_ABORT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT:
+                state.error = "Push transfer timed out"
+            if state.error or state.metadata is None:
+                continue
+            assert state.consumer_engine_id is not None
+            if not (wait or force) and state.consumer_engine_id in self._sending_futures:
+                continue
+            for rank, destination in state.destinations.items():
+                if state.error or destination.completion is not None:
+                    continue
+                assert destination.metadata_future is not None
+                if not destination.metadata_future.done():
+                    continue
+                try:
+                    remote = destination.metadata_future.result()
+                    if state.expected_ranks is None:
+                        expected = {
+                            (pp, pcp, tp)
+                            for pp in range(remote.pp_size)
+                            for pcp in range(remote.pcp_size)
+                            for tp in range(remote.tp_size)
+                        }
+                        if set(state.destinations) != expected:
+                            raise ValueError("D worker endpoints do not match its topology")
+                        state.expected_ranks = expected
+                    if destination.required_layers is None:
+                        destination.required_layers = {
+                            name
+                            for name in self._layer_indices
+                            if self._get_transfer_partition(name, remote, rank) is not None
+                        }
+                    for layer_name in state.available_layers:
+                        if layer_name not in destination.required_layers or layer_name in destination.pending_layers:
+                            continue
+                        task = self._build_layer_transfer_request(request_id, state, destination, layer_name)
+                        if task is not None:
+                            request, event = task
+                            key = (state.consumer_engine_id, rank, layer_name, id(event))
+                            entry = batches.setdefault(key, (remote, event, []))
+                            entry[2].append(request)
+                            destination.pending_layers.add(layer_name)
+                except Exception as exc:
+                    state.error = str(exc) or type(exc).__name__
+                    logger.exception("Failed to prepare Push transfer %s", request_id)
+        for (engine_id, rank, layer_name, _), (remote, event, requests) in batches.items():
+            # A later layer/destination may have failed while building this pass.
+            active = []
+            for req in requests:
+                state = self._reqs_send_state[req.request_id]
+                if state.error is None:
+                    active.append(req)
+                else:
+                    state.destinations[rank].pending_layers.remove(layer_name)
+            if active:
+                batch = LayerTransferBatch(layer_name, rank, remote, tuple(active), event)
+                assert self._sender_executor is not None
+                future = self._sender_executor.submit(self._execute_layer_transfer, batch)
+                self._pending_sends.append((batch, future))
+                self._sending_futures.setdefault(engine_id, []).append(future)
+
+    def _send_done_after_transfers(self, params: dict[str, Any], error: str | None, transfers: list[Future]) -> bool:
+        # This task is submitted after all its dependencies. Its Future includes
+        # the notification itself, unlike a WRITE Future's add_done_callback.
+        for future in transfers:
+            try:
+                transfer_error = future.result()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                transfer_error = str(exc) or type(exc).__name__
+            error = error or transfer_error
+        return self._send_done(params, error)
+
+    def _send_completions(self) -> None:
+        """Queue DONE after a request's complete set of submitted WRITEs."""
+        transfers_by_request: dict[str, list[Future]] = {}
+        pending_by_request: dict[str, dict[WorkerRank, dict[str, int]]] = {}
+        for batch, future in self._pending_sends:
+            for request in batch.requests:
+                transfers_by_request.setdefault(request.request_id, []).append(future)
+                pending_tokens = pending_by_request.setdefault(request.request_id, {})
+                pending_tokens.setdefault(batch.remote_rank, {})[batch.layer_name] = request.end_token
+        for request_id, state in self._reqs_send_state.items():
+            transfers = transfers_by_request.get(request_id, [])
+            pending_tokens = pending_by_request.get(request_id, {})
+            for rank, destination in state.destinations.items():
+                if destination.completion is not None:
+                    continue
+                pending = pending_tokens.get(rank, {})
+                end = (
+                    destination.transfer_params["num_computed_tokens"]
+                    + destination.transfer_params["num_external_tokens"]
+                )
+                complete = destination.required_layers is not None and all(
+                    max(destination.sent_tokens.get(layer, -1), pending.get(layer, -1)) >= end
+                    for layer in destination.required_layers
+                )
+                if state.error or complete:
+                    assert self._sender_executor is not None
+                    destination.completion = self._sender_executor.submit(
+                        self._send_done_after_transfers, destination.transfer_params, state.error, transfers
+                    )
+
+    def save_kv_layer(self, layer_name: str) -> None:
+        if not self.kv_transfer_config.is_kv_producer or not self._prefilling_request_ids:
+            return
+        layer_index = self._layer_index_by_name.get(layer_name)
+        if layer_index is None:
+            return
+        # Share one fence across the physical layer's caches and requests.
+        # Duplicate hooks with no new tokens do not record another device event.
+        layer_names = self._layer_names_by_index[layer_index]
+        event = None
+        for request_id in self._prefilling_request_ids:
+            state = self._reqs_send_state[request_id]
+            if state.error:
+                continue
+            assert state.metadata is not None
+            end = state.metadata.num_computed_tokens + state.metadata.num_scheduled_tokens
+            for cache_name in layer_names:
+                if state.available_layers.get(cache_name, (-1, None))[0] < end:
+                    if event is None:
+                        event = torch.npu.Event()

+            self._process_sending_requests(layer_hook=True, force=last_layer)
+        if last_layer:
+            self._send_completions()
+
+    def wait_for_save(self) -> None:
+        if not self.kv_transfer_config.is_kv_producer or not self._reqs_send_state:
+            return
+        # Includes cancelled requests and connector-only steps. Check deadlines
+        # at the step boundary instead of on every layer hook.
+        now = time.monotonic()
+        for state in self._reqs_send_state.values():
+            if state.error is None and now - state.start_time > envs.VLLM_MOONCAKE_ABORT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT:
+                state.error = "Push transfer timed out"
+        # End-of-forward fallback for Mamba/auxiliary caches without named hooks.
+        event = None
+        for request_id in self._prefilling_request_ids:
+            state = self._reqs_send_state[request_id]
+            if state.error:
+                continue
+            assert state.metadata is not None
+            end = state.metadata.num_computed_tokens + state.metadata.num_scheduled_tokens
+            for layer_name in self._layer_indices:
+                if state.available_layers.get(layer_name, (-1, None))[0] < end:
+                    if event is None:
+                        event = torch.npu.Event()
+                        event.record()
+                    state.available_layers[layer_name] = end, event
+        # A late metadata query must not leave this step's KV unsent when core
+        # handles normal completion and immediately releases the source blocks.
+        wait_futures(
+            {
+                dest.metadata_future
+                for state in self._reqs_send_state.values()
+                if state.error is None
+                for dest in state.destinations.values()
+                if dest.completion is None and dest.metadata_future is not None
+            }
+        )
+        self._process_sending_requests(wait=True)
+        # Drain tasks just submitted above before the next step can overwrite
+        # window/state pages or the scheduler can recycle any source blocks.
+        while self._pending_sends:
+            self._process_sending_requests(wait=True)
+        self._send_completions()
+        wait_futures(
+            dest.completion
+            for state in self._reqs_send_state.values()
+            for dest in state.destinations.values()
+            if dest.completion is not None
+        )
+        self._prefilling_request_ids = ()
+
+    def maybe_raise_thread_error(self) -> None:
+        thread = self._decode_listener_thread
+        if thread is not None and thread.error is not None:
+            raise RuntimeError("Push completion listener failed") from thread.error
+
+    def get_transfer_results(self) -> KVConnectorTransferResults:
+        self.maybe_raise_thread_error()
+        results = KVConnectorTransferResults()
+        if self.kv_transfer_config.is_kv_producer:
+            for request_id, send_state in list(self._reqs_send_state.items()):
+                if send_state.inference_finished and all(
+                    not dest.pending_layers and dest.completion is not None and dest.completion.done()
+                    for dest in send_state.destinations.values()
+                ):
+                    results.finished_sending.add(send_state.local_request_id)
+                    del self._reqs_send_state[request_id]
+        else:
+            while True:
+                try:
+                    kind, request_id, payload = self._result_queue.get_nowait()
+                except queue.Empty:
+                    break
+                if request_id in self._finished_requests:
+                    continue
+                state = self._reqs_recv_state.get(request_id)
+                if state is None:
+                    # Proxy may dispatch P before D's allocation metadata reaches
+                    # this worker. Preserve early DONE, deduplicated by source.
+                    pending = self._pending_completions.setdefault(request_id, {})
+                    source_key = (
+                        payload["producer_engine_id"],
+                        tuple(payload["producer_sizes"]),
+                        tuple(payload["producer_rank"]),
+                        payload["status"],
+                    )
+                    pending[source_key] = payload
+                    continue
+                if kind == "failed":
+                    results.finished_recving.add(state.request_id)
+                    results.failed_recving.add(state.request_id)
+                    self._finished_requests[request_id] = True
+                    del self._reqs_recv_state[request_id]
+                    continue
+                if not state.expected_ranks:
+                    sizes = payload["producer_sizes"]
+                    state.expected_ranks = {
+                        (pp, pcp, tp) for pp in range(sizes[0]) for pcp in range(sizes[1]) for tp in range(sizes[2])
+                    }
+                source = tuple(payload["producer_rank"])
+                state.failed |= payload["status"] == "error"
+                if source in state.finished_ranks:
+                    continue
+                state.finished_ranks.add(source)
+                if state.finished_ranks == state.expected_ranks:
+                    results.finished_recving.add(state.request_id)
+                    if state.failed:
+                        results.failed_recving.add(state.request_id)
+                    self._finished_requests[request_id] = True
+                    del self._reqs_recv_state[request_id]
+            for request_id, state in list(self._reqs_recv_state.items()):
+                if time.monotonic() - state.start_time > envs.VLLM_MOONCAKE_ABORT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT:
+                    logger.error("Missing terminal Push completion for request %s", state.request_id)
+                    results.finished_recving.add(state.request_id)
+                    results.failed_recving.add(state.request_id)
+                    self._finished_requests[request_id] = True
+                    del self._reqs_recv_state[request_id]
+        return results
+
+    def get_block_ids_with_load_errors(self) -> set[int]:
+        # Request results and control errors are handled by get_transfer_results.
+        return set()
+
+    def shutdown(self) -> None:
+        self._stop_event.set()
+        for thread in (self._decode_listener_thread,):
+            if thread is not None:
+                thread.shutdown()
+        if self._sender_executor is not None:
+            self._sender_executor.shutdown(wait=True)
+            self._sender_executor = None
+        if self._zmq_context is not None:
+            self._zmq_context.destroy(linger=0)
+            self._zmq_context = None

+class MooncakeMetaserverClient:
+    """Submit D metadata in the background and surface failures to the scheduler."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        # The metaserver responds after P finishes, not when it accepts D's
+        # metadata. Allow the request lifetime for that response.
+        self.client = httpx.Client(
+            timeout=httpx.Timeout(
+                envs.VLLM_MOONCAKE_ABORT_REQUEST_TIMEOUT,
+                connect=envs.VLLM_MOONCAKE_CONNECTOR_TIMEOUT,
+            )
+        )
+        # Each D DP engine has its own pool: at most 32 metaserver POSTs can
+        # run concurrently, and each occupies a thread until P finishes.
+        # TODO: decouple metadata acceptance from P completion. A multi-prompt
+        # batch can exhaust this pool while the proxy waits for its remaining
+        # queued metadata, causing all involved POSTs to wait until timeout.
+        self.executor = ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=32, thread_name_prefix="MooncakeMetaserver")
+        self._results: queue.SimpleQueue = queue.SimpleQueue()
+
+    def submit(self, request_id: str, url: str | None, message: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        try:
+            if not isinstance(url, str):
+                raise ValueError("Metaserver URL is missing or is not a string")
+            parsed_url = httpx.URL(url)
+            if parsed_url.scheme not in ("http", "https") or not parsed_url.host:
+                raise ValueError("Metaserver requires an absolute HTTP(S) URL")
+        except (TypeError, ValueError, httpx.InvalidURL) as error:
+            self._results.put((request_id, error, True))
+            return
+
+        # submit() can enqueue work before starting a thread raises. Gate the
+        # HTTP call so a rejected submission can never publish D block addresses.
+        submitted = threading.Event()
+        accepted = False
+
+        def send() -> None:
+            submitted.wait()
+            if accepted:
+                self._access_metaserver(url, message)
+
+        try:
+            future = self.executor.submit(send)
+        except RuntimeError as error:
+            self._results.put((request_id, error, True))
+        else:
+            accepted = True
+            future.add_done_callback(lambda result: self._on_done(request_id, result))
+        finally:
+            submitted.set()
+
+    def _access_metaserver(self, url: str, message: dict[str, Any]) -> None:
+        # Only connection establishment is retried: a lost response may follow
+        # a successful P dispatch, so do not replay the request after a timeout.
+        for attempt in range(3):
+            try:
+                response = self.client.post(url, json=message)
+                response.raise_for_status()
+                return
+            except (httpx.ConnectError, httpx.ConnectTimeout):
+                if attempt == 2:
+                    raise
+
+    def _on_done(self, request_id: str, future: Future) -> None:
+        if not future.cancelled() and (error := future.exception()) is not None:
+            not_dispatched = isinstance(error, (httpx.ConnectError, httpx.ConnectTimeout))
+            self._results.put((request_id, error, not_dispatched))
+
+    def get_failed_requests(self) -> dict[str, bool]:
+        """Return failed D requests and whether P dispatch can be ruled out."""
+        failed_requests: dict[str, bool] = {}
+        while True:
+            try:
+                request_id, error, not_dispatched = self._results.get_nowait()
+            except queue.Empty:
+                return failed_requests
+            logger.error("Mooncake metaserver dispatch failed for %s: %s", request_id, error)
+            # Preserve uncertainty if more than one failure was recorded.
+            failed_requests[request_id] = failed_requests.get(request_id, True) and not_dispatched
+
+    def shutdown(self) -> None:
+        try:
+            self.executor.shutdown(wait=True, cancel_futures=True)
+        finally:
+            self.client.close()
+

[Refactor] Remove obsolete adaptive verification DP sync workaround (#21446)

### What this PR does / why we need it?
Remove the adaptive verification DP sync workaround introduced by
#18249.

Previously, the drafter could inherit the target graph's padded request
capacity, inflating draft request and token counts under DP. This
behavior is tracked in [vLLM
#61806](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/61806) and addressed
by [vLLM #58984](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/58984), which
is included in both v0.33.0 and the current verified vLLM commit.

- Removes the AV-specific clearing of the target DP sync state.
- Removes the Ascend-side idle dummy request-count restoration.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
N/A

### How was this patch tested?
by ci

---

### Checklist

#### Testing

- [x] **Boundary / edge-case coverage**: I reviewed whether this change
involves
boundary conditions (e.g. empty input, single/zero element, min/max
values,
off-by-one, sequence-length limits, integer overflow). Where applicable,
I
added unit tests covering these edge cases in `tests/ut/` or
`tests/e2e/`.
- [x] **Regression test**: If this PR fixes a bug, I added a regression
test
  that would fail without the fix.
- [x] **Error / failure path coverage**: I covered abnormal paths
(exceptions,
timeouts, out-of-range, division by zero) in addition to the happy path.
- [x] **Meaningful & reliable tests**: New tests assert real behavior
and are
  not written merely to satisfy CI.
- [x] **Performance impact**: If this PR touches a performance-sensitive
path,
  I attached benchmark results and added performance regression tests.

[BugFix] Adapt DFlash sampler tests to DraftLogitsCache (#21522)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

The vLLM refactor in vllm-project/vllm#64356 changed the draft-logits
argument to `CandidateSampler.sample`. The DFlash sampler tests still
pass a tensor and seven cases fail when the sampler reads `row_mapping`.

CI and assert on its backing logits tensor. The `vllm-ascend` main
branch also runs A3/A5 nightly against vLLM v0.33.0, whose sampler still
accepts a tensor. Keep that test input for nightly and run the same
assertions and rejection-sampling checks on both versions.

[Failing A3 CI
job](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/42767543196/job/129684921927?pr=21334)

[Test][Misc] Adjust Kimi-K3-MRV2-A3 GPQA baseline to 95 (#21001)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

This PR updates the GPQA accuracy assertion for the Kimi-K3-MRV2-A3 E2E
test. The range check changes from `baseline: 93` / `threshold: 3` to
`baseline: 95` / `threshold: 5`.

`AisbenchRunner` defaults `verify_mode` to `range` and asserts `baseline
- threshold <= accuracy <= baseline + threshold`, so the accepted window
becomes 90–100 (absolute percentage points) instead of 90–96. The lower
bound stays at 90, matching the original window, while the upper bound
is raised to 100 because the [nightly
run](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/41853642770/job/126659757860)
reported 96.67% accuracy, which exceeded the previous upper bound of 96
and failed the check.

No. This is a test configuration update only.

- Parsed the updated YAML with PyYAML.
- Executed the existing `AisbenchRunner._accuracy_verify` range check
with supplied scores: 89.99 is rejected; 90, 93.33, 96.67 and 100 pass.

files are included. Multi-node NPU E2E validation remains pending in CI.

[Performance] Overlap PCP prefill communication and reduce KDA output collectives (#20454)

### What this PR does / why we need it?

PCP prefill needs to exchange main-KV and KPool inputs across ranks.
Waiting for these AllGathers before running independent query
projections leaves communication on the critical path. KDA also reduces
the full output on every PCP rank before selecting only that rank's
token rows.

This PR reduces those exposed waits and redundant output communication:

- **Main-KV overlap:** launch the PCP AllGather before MLA query
projections and wait when the gathered values are needed for the cache
write. Use one `exec_kv` path for immediate and deferred completion,
with DCP slot selection in one entry point. Offload accepts the same
signature while completing its existing cache writes and CPU commits
synchronously. Keep the send buffers alive until communication
completes.
- **KPool overlap and gather ordering:** start the hidden-state
AllGather before MLA/indexer query computation and restore token order
at the KPool consumer. Keep contiguous send buffers alive until the
consumer waits for completion. In native SFA preprocessing, enqueue
main-KV and KPool gathers before output-projection weight/scale gathers,
whose results are consumed later.
- **KDA ReduceScatter:** pack output rows by PCP ownership and replace
AllReduce followed by local row selection with ReduceScatter, so each
rank receives its own reduced rows. Preserve the existing SP and other
fallback paths.

The changes preserve token ordering, padding, replicated decode
prefixes, cache-write semantics, and graph-owned output buffers.
Ordinary sparse indexers retain their original K/scale gather and
cache-write pipeline.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

The communication optimizations activate automatically on the applicable
PCP paths. No new user-facing options are introduced. Release note:
`release_notes/fragments/20454.yaml`.

### How was this patch tested?

**Performance — long-prompt prefill**

AISBench synthetic fixed-token workload on GLM-5.3-Flash, measured
before the final KV entry-point refactor:

- **131,072 input tokens and 1 output token per request; 200 requests at
client concurrency 200**, using non-streaming responses.
- Each request has **117,504 cached input tokens and 13,568 newly
computed tokens**. Both variants use the same input token sequences and
cache-hit counts.
- Each variant starts from a fresh service load, primes the shared
prefix, and runs one 200-request warmup before one measured 200-request
batch. Preparation and warmup are excluded from the results.

| Metric | Baseline | PR | Change |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Mean TTFT | 48.367578 s | 46.376675 s | −4.12% |
| Input token throughput | 276,079.40 tokens/s | 287,386.83 tokens/s |
+4.10% |

Both benchmark environments included the same external FP8 startup
compatibility patch. Both sides completed **200/200 requests with zero
preemption**. AISBench results were independently checked against all
per-request timing records. For this non-streaming, one-output-token
case, AISBench TTFT equals request latency. Input throughput counts all
input tokens, including cache hits.

**GPQA-Diamond — reasoning accuracy**

The full **198-question multiple-choice dataset** is scored with
AISBench's zero-shot CoT prompt, answer extraction, and GPQA evaluator.
The PR evaluation uses **client concurrency 32** and an output limit of
**131,072 tokens per question**, with normal EOS stopping.

| Metric | Baseline | PR |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Correct / total | 180 / 198 | 181 / 198 |
| Accuracy | 90.9091% | 91.4141% |
| Successful requests | 198 / 198 | 198 / 198 |
